info.title: larpingapp demo data
info.description: Demo data covering every schema this app supplies, offered as the first step of the app's setup walkthrough. Generated from the schemas themselves, so every object satisfies the schema that will validate it.

x-openregister.description: Demo data for larpingapp. NOT installed automatically — a mock register is imported on demand, from the setup walkthrough or `occ openregister:descriptors:list --app=larpingapp --import=<slug>`.

larpinq.title: Larpinq (demo)
larpinq.description: Demo data for Larpinq. Generated from the register's own schemas — see hydra/scripts/generate-mock-register.py.

character.title: Character
character.summary: A playable or non-playable character in the LARP game
character.description: Represents a character entity with stats, skills, items, conditions, and event participation. Characters can be player characters, NPCs, or other types. Game masters approve characters before play.

name.description: The chosen in-game name for this character
name.title: Character Name

ocName.description: The player who plays this character. Pick an existing player or type a new name to create one.
ocName.title: Player

ownerUid.description: Auto-derived Nextcloud uid of the owning player's user account (materialised from the linked player). Not user-editable.
ownerUid.title: Owner UID

description.description: Public description visible to all players
description.title: Description

background.description: Character background story (visible to GMs only)
background.title: Background Story

faith.description: The faith or religion of the character
faith.title: Faith

slNotesPublic.description: Game master notes visible to players
slNotesPublic.title: Game Master Notes (Public)

slNotesPrivate.description: Game master notes NOT visible to players
slNotesPrivate.title: Game Master Notes (Private)

events.description: Events this character is subscribed to
events.title: Events

setting.description: Optional world (campaign) thischaracter belongs to. Empty means shared across all worlds.
setting.title: World

requirementOverrides.description: Explicit, audited GM overrides of unmet skill requirements. Each entry waives requirement enforcement for one skill assignment, recording who overrode it and why. Writing this field is restricted to game masters server-side.

skill.description: The assigned skill whose requirements are waived
skill.title: Skill

overriddenBy.description: Nextcloud uid of the GM who authored the override (server-stamped)
overriddenBy.title: Overridden By

requirementOverrides.title: Requirement Overrides

approved.description: Game master approves the character for play.

player.title: Player
player.summary: A real-world player participating in the LARP
player.description: Represents a player who controls one or more characters. Tracks player identity and contact information.

userUid.description: The Nextcloud user account this player signs in as (a Nextcloud user UID — a plain string; there is deliberately no `format`, OpenRegister has no `user` format and rejects the whole schema when it sees one). Used for character-ownership notifications.
userUid.title: Nextcloud user

ability.title: Ability
ability.summary: A numeric stat tracked on characters (e.g., XP, Mana, Health)
ability.description: Represents a numeric ability or stat that characters track. Effects modify abilities by adding or subtracting from the base value. Used for experience points, mana, health, armor, and other quantifiable attributes.

name.description: Unique name of the ability (e.g., Experience Points, Mana)
name.title: Ability Name

description.description: What this ability represents within the game world
description.title: Description

setting.description: Optional world (campaign) thisability belongs to. Empty means shared across all worlds.
setting.title: World

skill.title: Skill
skill.summary: A learnable ability that characters can acquire
skill.description: Represents a skill that characters can learn, usually purchased with experience points. Skills provide effects and may have prerequisites (other skills, stats, conditions, or effects).

name.description: Name of the skill (e.g., Healing LvL 1)
name.title: Skill Name

description.description: In-game flavor description of the skill
description.title: Description

effect.description: Technical description of what the skill does mechanically
effect.title: Mechanical Effect

effects.description: Effects applied when this skill is taken
effects.title: Effects

requiredSkills.description: Prerequisite skills needed before learning this skill
requiredSkills.title: Required Skills

requiredScore.description: Minimum ability score needed when requirements are abilities
requiredScore.title: Required Score

setting.description: Optional world (campaign) thisskill belongs to. Empty means shared across all worlds.
setting.title: World

item.title: Item
item.summary: A magical or special item that characters can own
item.description: Represents a special or magical item in the game. Items provide effects to their holder. Items can be unique artifacts (only one instance exists) or regular items.

effect.description: Technical description of item effects (GM-visible only)
effect.title: Mechanical Effect

effects.description: Predefined effects applied to the item holder
effects.title: Effects

unique.description: Whether this is a unique artifact (only one instance can exist)
unique.title: Unique Artifact

setting.description: Optional world (campaign) thisitem belongs to. Empty means shared across all worlds.
setting.title: World

condition.title: Condition
condition.summary: A positive or negative condition affecting characters
condition.description: Represents a condition that can be applied to characters as a consequence of gameplay. Conditions differ from skills in that they are not purchased but earned through in-game events.

effect.description: Mechanical description of what the condition does
effect.title: Mechanical Effect

effects.description: Automated effects applied by this condition
effects.title: Effects

unique.description: Whether only one character can have this condition at a time
unique.title: Unique Condition

characters.description: Characters currently affected by this condition
characters.title: Affected Characters

setting.description: Optional world (campaign) thiscondition belongs to. Empty means shared across all worlds.
setting.title: World

effect.title: Effect
effect.summary: A calculated modification to a character ability
effect.description: Represents a numeric modification to one or more abilities. Effects come from skills, items, conditions, or events and automatically adjust character stats.

modifier.description: The numeric value applied to the ability
modifier.title: Modifier Value

modification.description: Whether the modification is positive or negative
modification.title: Modification

cumulative.description: Whether the effect can stack on a character
cumulative.title: Cumulative

setting.description: Optional world (campaign) thiseffect belongs to. Empty means shared across all worlds.
setting.title: World

event.title: Event
event.summary: A LARP event or gathering where players come together
event.description: Represents a LARP event — a gathering where players come with their characters. Can be multi-day events or casual meetups. Characters subscribe to events and receive effects after the event.

effects.description: Effects applied to participating characters after the event
effects.title: Post-Event Effects

setting.description: Optional world (campaign) thisevent belongs to. Empty means shared across all worlds.
setting.title: World
World
setting.description: A first-class LARP world: a game world or campaign that organises characters, events, and mechanics. Real organisations run several campaigns (a fantasy summer world, a sci-fi winter world) with disjoint rosters and rule sets. Game entities can optionally be scoped to a world; entities without one are shared across all worlds. Finished campaigns are archived rather than deleted. NAMING: the slug and the property key stay `setting` because they are persisted OpenRegister data; only the human-readable title/summary/description use the domain word. The old title "Setting" was translated as a UI preference (Einstellung / Paramètre / Configuración) by all 35 non-Dutch locales.

name.description: The name of the setting / campaign
name.title: Setting Name

xpAward.title: XP Award
xpAward.summary: A per-participant experience-point grant for an event
xpAward.description: Records a single experience-point award made by a game master to one character for one event. The post-event awarding ritual produces one xpAward per grant: who earned how much, why, and who granted it. Awards feed the character's computed XP ability as a fifth stat-engine stage. Writes are restricted to game masters; reads are open to authenticated app users.

event.description: The event this award was granted for
event.title: Event

amount.description: The positive amount of experience points awarded
amount.title: XP Amount

reason.description: Optional reason for the award (e.g. full attendance, plot bonus)
reason.title: Award Reason

awardedBy.description: Nextcloud uid of the game master who granted the award (server-stamped)
awardedBy.title: Awarded By
